name: Primal Mantle
description: Wear the oldest stone of the ground as a mantle that guards the body and fills it with strength.

name: Ancient Press
description: Lay the weight of old deep rock on the foe until their limbs refuse to rise.

name: Rooted Titan
description: Strike with a fist rooted through the core into the bedrock so it lands as the ground itself.

name: Foundation Sense
description: Read the whole bedrock of a wide region at once and mark every living step upon it.

name: Titan Quake
description: Raise a titan's quake from the deep rock that tears the ground in a vast circle.

name: Ageless Pillar
description: Raise a pillar as old as the mountain from below and drive it through the foe.

name: Deepstone Prison
description: Close a prison of deep stone round one or many foes and seal it until the user lets it go.

name: Adamant Throne
description: Take a seat in a raised throne of rock that shields the user and makes each blow heavier.

name: Primeval Fall
description: Bring down a mass of primeval stone on a wide front with a weight set by the core's reserve.

name: Bedrock Sovereignty
description: Claim the bedrock of a region as the user's own so that no foe on it can shake it.

name: Everstone Descent
description: Drop a pillar of unbreakable stone onto a single foe with a weight that grows with the master's core.

name: Land Sundering
description: Break the ground of a whole vale from edge to edge and bring it down to the destructive ceiling of a Core-tier master.

name: Earthen Memory
description: Call the ground to recall its past and set a stretch of land back as it stood an hour ago; no mechanic explains this.

name: First Footing
description: Plant the first footing beneath the body so that nothing in the world can move the stance.

name: Primal Press
description: Let the weight of the world's first stone press on the foes until they kneel.

name: Elder Quake
description: Wake a slow old quake in the deep earth and send it rolling through the ranks.

name: Deep Reading
description: Read the old layers of the world through the divine energy and learn what lies beneath a whole land.

name: Foundation Titan
description: Raise a titan from the world's foundation and let it strike down from above.

name: Worldroot Hold
description: Twist the roots of the land about the foes and hold them fast until the master chooses.

name: Ancient Anchor
description: Drop an ancient anchor of stone through the ground that shields allies and steadies their strikes.

name: Elder Rend
description: Tear the old ground across the front in a long ragged rend that opens into the deep.

name: Original Mass
description: Let the first mass of the world fall on one foe with a weight set by the divine energy gathered.

name: Foundation Judgment
description: Judge a whole host and press every one of them down with a weight that follows the master's reserve.

name: Primeval Anchor
description: Anchor the user to the world's first stone so no force can move them and no foe can pass.

name: Land Collapse
description: Drop an entire province of ground into the deep and ruin all of it up to the ceiling of a divine master.

name: Bedrock Genesis
description: Set down a new foundation where none lay and the land accepts it as always there; no energy mechanic explains why the world agrees.

name: Unformed Rend
description: Unmake a stretch of ground back to before it was formed so that all upon it fall through; no energy mechanic explains the undoing.
